description: Creates a payin from a payin quote and returns the instructions the payer uses to send funds (for example a Pix code or bank details). Create it before the payin quote expires. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry cannot create a second payin. On development instances the payin completes on its own about 30 seconds after creation; request_amount 66600 makes it fail and 77700 makes it refunded.

Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key to safely retry this request without performing the action twice. Retrying with the same key and an identical body replays the original response; reusing a key with a different body returns an error. Keys are kept for 24 hours.
